text:
Dear colleagues,

I’m doing a quick safety review for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways to make sure our rabbit workflow stays consistent end-to-end. Our priority is safe movement and clear documentation at each handoff, and the senior coordinator supports daily decisions with that in mind.

For rabbit, the health certificate stays valid for 41 days from the issued date. Cabin team members also keep a close eye on Ruby during flight, supporting comfort and calm while the ground process stays tidy and controlled.

Please remember that a reliable check-in sequence matters as much as the in-cabin monitoring. Verify carrier condition and secure fit before boarding, confirm that the paperwork set matches the traveler details, and ensure the contact notes are easy to find for any quick follow-up. If any discrepancy shows up, pause the chain rather than rushing; speed only helps when everything is aligned. Grace Park and Lucia Tanaka may rely on us for smooth communication, so clear expectations and careful timing should come first.

Thanks for staying attentive and for keeping our animals and routes safe through every trip we support.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
